items.title: Announcing AWS Common Runtime (CRT) v1.0.0
items.summary: We are happy to announce that AWS Common Runtime (CRT) v1.0.0 is generally available (GA). The CRT is a family of open source libraries written in C. It implements building blocks that AWS SDKs and Tools share, giving you a production-ready foundation for fast HTTP, Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) and MQTT clients in […]
